coverage.description: One male Digimouse specimen in a simulated posture. Every structure declares whether it is source-labelled, traced from the source images or simulated.

processingResolution.method: Surfaces from source labels and images, moved to a simulated standing posture, with simulated layers added
limitations: This is a constructed model, not a measurement of a living mouse.
The posture, coat and all structures marked simulated are estimates and are not measured.
